build_caudal_joints: build caudal spine joints with configurable degrees of freedom per vertebra in the dog model
add_collision_geoms: add collision primitive geometries to each caudal vertebra bone in the dog tail
review_create_tail: review the create_tail function that adds tail bodies, joints, and collision geoms to a dog model
summarize_create_tail: summarize the create_tail function which builds a 21-vertebra tail with extend and bend joints
